name: Live dashboard
definition: The two-dimensional Interface presentation that groups the current model's actual widgets into Simulation, Controls and Live Analytics. It changes their presentation, not their definitions or saved positions.

name: Simulation panel
definition: The dashboard area for the live world view. It shows the same native simulation as the original canvas, not an independent run or a screenshot.

name: Control grid
definition: The dashboard's arrangement of existing inputs and action widgets. The number of columns adapts to available space; a slider's model variable and a button's commands do not change when it moves.

name: Live Analytics
definition: The dashboard area for the model's native monitors and plots. Output depends on the widgets and reporter or pen updates the model actually defines.

name: Original canvas
definition: The model's saved Interface arrangement. Turn off Live dashboard or enter Interface editing to use it; dashboard placement does not overwrite saved widget coordinates.

name: Hide chat
keywords: collapse assistant dock show chat preference
definition: Collapses the native assistant dock to a Show chat rail. The embedded assistant stays attached, retaining its conversation. It does not stop the simulation or cancel an assistant operation.

name: Show chat
keywords: expand assistant restore dock hide chat
definition: Reopens the collapsed assistant dock from the native rail or the Tools menu. The collapsed preference is remembered so the workspace can reopen with chat out of the way.

name: Assistant project
keywords: chat conversation model selector local storage
definition: A locally stored conversation and model specification. Restoring a project may replace the desktop's open model, so save independent file edits before switching.

name: Provider and model
keywords: llm settings api base url credential model id
definition: The saved assistant connection and model identifier used for requests. Provider connectivity and tool support are separate from whether the local desktop engine can run a model.

name: Tool activity
keywords: assistant changes code widgets commands results
definition: Operations shown in the assistant conversation, such as inspecting or modifying the live model, running commands, or retrieving results. Review what actually ran rather than treating the assistant's summary as evidence.

name: Engine connection
keywords: native desktop bridge status local runtime webview
definition: The assistant or modeler's link to the native desktop document and its running engine. It is not the LLM provider connection; desktop simulations can run without a configured language model.

name: Info tab
definition: The model's own documentation pane. Use it for instructions, assumptions, units, limitations and credits. Save the desktop model to preserve Info edits.

name: Info export to Word
keywords: docx report export word images alt text
definition: The Info toolbar action that exports model documentation as a .docx file. Supported text structure is retained and images become alternative text; it does not capture live plots, chat, or experiment data.

name: System Dynamics Modeler
keywords: stock flow diagram tools native window
definition: The separate editor opened from Tools to draft and inspect stock-and-flow models. It communicates with the open native document and uses the existing System Dynamics runtime, not a second solver.

name: Save element
definition: Commits the edited element fields to the modeler's diagram draft. This is not Apply to model and does not save the desktop model file.

name: Unapplied changes
keywords: dirty diagram draft close hide undo compare
definition: Indicator that the draft differs from its applied baseline. Hiding the modeler can retain the in-memory draft; closing its window is not a reliable way to discard or save that work.

name: Check structure
definition: The modeler's diagram-level check. It does not replace applying and compiling against the connected document, or checking that the model gives scientifically meaningful results.

name: Apply to model
keywords: apply draft compile desktop reset reinitialize
definition: Attempts to load and compile the diagram draft in the open desktop model. Applying resets runtime state; after a successful apply, run setup and save the desktop file separately.

name: Apply conflict
keywords: desktop changed snapshot draft stale recovery
definition: A warning that the desktop document no longer matches the draft's baseline. Preserve the draft and desktop file separately before recovering; avoid applying a stale diagram over newer work.

name: Connect stocks
definition: Select a source stock and then a destination stock in the modeler to define a connection. Configure the flow equation and units rather than assuming the diagram arrow by itself defines a rate.

name: Stock
definition: An accumulated quantity such as water volume. The model sets its initial value and updates it from inflows and outflows; the stock and its flow rates normally have different units.

name: Flow
definition: A rate that changes one or more stocks. A transfer between stocks subtracts from its source and adds to its destination; an outside endpoint crosses the modeled boundary.

name: Auxiliary
definition: A calculated quantity or constant used in diagram equations, such as a fractional drain rate. It is not an accumulating stock.

name: Outside (cloud)
definition: The external endpoint option for a flow entering or leaving the modeled system. The cloud is not a stock with a hidden initial value.

name: Influence arrow
definition: A visual dependency indicator. Drawing the arrow does not rewrite formulas; flows, not arrows to a stock, determine stock accumulation.

name: Derive from equations
definition: A diagram action that derives dependencies from existing formulas. Inspect the expressions to verify what is used by each rate or auxiliary.

name: Timestep (dt)
definition: The positive numerical integration interval in modeled time units. It affects the integration, unlike the display speed setting. Do not assume a displayed tick equals one unit of modeled time.

name: Generated procedures
definition: The modeler view of the engine's generated System Dynamics code after applying. The enclosing model still needs its own initialization and execution procedures to call the corresponding generated procedures.

name: Stock history
keywords: simulation results rolling samples plot ticks
definition: The modeler's chart of recent sampled stock values. It is a rolling display, not a permanent archive; save numerical results separately for comparison or reporting.

name: Export JSON
definition: Saves the modeler's diagram separately as JSON, useful for preserving draft work before resolving a conflict. It is not a replacement for saving the full native model.

name: Import diagram
definition: Loads a compatible diagram JSON file or a diagram from a supported model file into the draft. Review and apply it deliberately before expecting changes in the desktop simulation.

name: Native model file
definition: The desktop document containing the model's code, Interface, Info and supported sections. Saving it is distinct from project storage or preserving the state and measurement history of a particular run.

name: BehaviorSpace experiment
keywords: parameter sweep repetition batch headless metrics
definition: A saved definition for repeated model runs with specified commands, parameter values, repetitions, reporters and stopping criteria. It is a batch experiment rather than a recording of the visible dashboard.

name: Abbreviated experiment results
keywords: batch truncation preview metrics full csv
definition: The assistant may display only a subset of a batch run's data. If truncated, the last displayed row may not be the final result; retain full native experiment output for analysis.
